stories.title: Why We Care So Much What People Think
stories.hook: Your brain treats being ignored like physical pain. Here's the research that proves it.

key_facts.claim: Social exclusion activates the same brain regions as physical pain.

stories.title: Nobody Is Looking At You As Much As You Think
stories.hook: You remember that awkward moment forever. Everyone else forgot it in ten seconds.

key_facts.claim: People overestimate how much others notice their appearance or mistakes.
key_facts.source: Gilovich, Medvec & Savitsky, the spotlight effect
